reason: Most of my business is old buyers who just call or WhatsApp me, and I quote from my head or my Excel. Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month to a small remote studio I have never met, with one past project to show, is too much risk for something I am not sure I need.
objection: If this small studio shuts down or stops answering in a year, who maintains my site and this quote system? I will be stuck again like with my nephew's website, and I will have paid Rs 5,000 every month for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: Meeting them face to face or talking to that chemical-trading client directly, plus a written promise that I own the website, domain and price list and can take everything to someone else if they disappear.
